annotations.title: NY attorney fee split with prior counsel

description: Divides an attorney fee between the current attorney and one or two prior counsel the way every Comp Desk tile does: each prior counsel gets the dollar amount given, the current attorney the rest, worked in whole cents; prior amounts above the fee are flagged as over-allocated (nothing can be requested). Also gives the OC-400.1 amount: the current attorney's share rounded down to the nearest $5. The fee the Board approves can differ. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core, the same engine as the app and the Pro Workspace; it never estimates. A missing input returns status "missing" and nothing is calculated. Returns the figures, the steps with the rule and engine function behind each, and the not-legal-advice notice.

prior_counsel_fees.description: Dollar amount of the fee apportioned to each prior counsel (one or two).

total_fee.description: The total attorney fee, in dollars (for example the fee a calculator returned).
